blocks.text: Once data has been collected, it is important to prepare it for analysis. This includes cleaning the data to remove errors or inconsistencies, organizing it in a meaningful way, and converting it into a format suitable for analysis. In cases where data is missing or incorrect, researchers may need to employ techniques such as interpolation or statistical adjustments to ensure accuracy.

Example: If survey responses contain incomplete information, missing values can be estimated based on the available data. Proper data preparation ensures that the analysis leads to reliable and valid results.
